# BenQ TI Tool

**Author:** Z3X-Team<br/>
**Platforms:** ODM

BenQ TI Tool reads and writes FullFlash and EEPROM, writes firmware and language packs. Version 1.0.3 supports BenQ T33 and M315, BenQ-Siemens EF61, and Siemens AP75.
